versions.changelog:
Initial release of zkrj-aigc-detect, providing direct AI-generated content detection via backend HTTP API (睿小鉴), without reliance on MCP server.

- Supports detection of images, texts, audio/video, and documents for AI-generation (AIGC/watermark) with confidence and evidence.
- Handles user authentication entirely via SMS code login and token management within the session.
- Returns structured detection results using required output templates and strict field preservation.
- Ensures brand disclaimer appears on every output and strictly prohibits fabricated detection results.
- Fully compliant with use-cases involving user-provided content or files, handling both local paths and in-chat content uploads.
